probe:
Dim Log As String
Sub Note(ByVal s As Variant)
    Log = Log & CStr(s) & "|"
End Sub
Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: ws.Range("A2").Value = 2: ws.Range("A3").Value = 3
    ws.Range("B1").Value = 4: ws.Range("B2").Value = 5: ws.Range("B3").Value = 6
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(10, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B3")
    ch.ChartType = xlLine
    On Error GoTo Failed
{action}
    GoTo Done
Failed:
    Log = Log & "!E" & Err.Number
Done:
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Log
End Function

rows.name: scale_last
rows.action:

Set c = ws.Range("A1:A3").FormatConditions.AddColorScale(2)

rows.name: pivot_axis
rows.action:
ws.Range("E1:F1").Value = Array("R", "N")
ws.Range("E2:F2").Value = Array("x", 1)
ws.Range("E3:F3").Value = Array("y", 2)
Dim pt As Object
Set pt = wb.PivotCaches.Create(xlDatabase, ws.Range("E1:F3")).CreatePivotTable(ws.Range("H3"), "P")
pt.PivotFields("R").Orientation = xlRowField
pt.AddDataField pt.PivotFields("N"), "Total", xlSum
Note TypeName(pt.PivotRowAxis.Parent) & "," & TypeName(pt.PivotRowAxis.Application) & "," & pt.PivotRowAxis.Creator
